engine_input_assumptions.credit: no CreditLine in the documents: budget unlimited, annual rate 20% (adapter default)
engine_input_assumptions.demand: monthly p50 = packs sold in the same calendar month of the last 12 months; p10/p90 = p50 -/+ 1.2816 x cv, cv = std/mean of the 12 monthly totals (coverage not calibrated)
engine_input_assumptions.excluded_routes: routes without a producer (air corridor) cannot be tied to a supplier: removed from the engine graph
engine_input_assumptions.freight_uzs: freight per pack / per shipment = 0 in the engine route: Ingest's CustomsEntry.fees_uzs is landed cost - CIP - duty and already contains the inbound freight (docs/MONOREPO.md stage 6a), so adding the USD rate card would count it twice (twin margin -2.3% instead of +0.6%); the USD rate card stays in the graph
engine_input_assumptions.horizon: plan horizon 2026-11..2027-10 (the 12 months after the documents); the truth evaluator replays the plan on the 12 truth months 2025-11..2026-10, i.e. next year is assumed to look like the last one
engine_input_assumptions.lot_size: 500 packs: every observed shipment is a multiple of 500
engine_input_assumptions.penalty: 0 UZS per unmet pack (not in any document)
engine_input_assumptions.reference_currency: registry Rn is stated in UZS: a UZS rate of 1 is added (reference currency = UZS)
engine_input_assumptions.reliability: 0.95 for every supplier (not in any document)
engine_input_assumptions.route_limits: min/max shipment packs = min/max shipment size seen in the documents on that route; max_shipments_per_year = shipments seen on that route in the last 12 months (the truth evaluator takes one order per month, so the total must stay <= 12); capacity_packs_per_year = max_shipments x max_shipment_packs; activation cost 0; is_eligible = True

plan_schedule: one shipment per month; line months used if given, else evenly spread; a taken month moves to the nearest free one; months without shipment are explicit zero orders
truth_overlay: scenario -> copy of truth tables: demand = scenario.demand/forecast p50 on window sales; USD rate ratio on fx, on the FX-linked share (CIP+duty) of landed unit cost; freight multiplier by mode on route rates; P22 cut = demand-weighted mean of monthly cap factors on the registry price; unavailable route = zero packs on it (no re-purchase). Not modelled on truth: emergency routes, hedge, supplier price differences.
